title: Read a text aloud into a sound file
prompt: Read the text of hello.txt aloud and save the sound as greeting.wav.
check: head -c4 greeting.wav | grep -q RIFF && { grep -qF "$(cat hello.txt)" greeting.wav || ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 greeting.wav | awk '{exit !($1 > 0.8)}'; }
